title: Velvety Slovakian Cauliflower Casserole
description: A hearty, whole30-friendly casserole featuring cauliflower, sweet and crumbly textures, and a simple preparation process. This dish is a delightful twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine.
instructions: Rinse the cauliflower and remove the leaves and stem.
Break the cauliflower into large florets and place them in a food processor.
Process the cauliflower until it resembles rice.
Transfer the cauliflower to a mixing bowl and stir in the almond flour, coconut oil, honey, eggs, vanilla extract, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the batter until it's smooth and free of lumps.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Sprinkle the cocoa powder, shredded coconut, and chopped walnuts evenly over the top of the cauliflower mixture.
Arrange the nigiri-shaped almonds on top of the casserole, leaving a 1-inch gap between each almond.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until it's golden brown and set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
